frontier.mechanism: The conservation law bites because floor_log2(26)*26 = 104 forces live_length > 65.5. At nrefs 15 the tier drops to floor_log2(15) = 3, so the requirement collapses to live_length > 28.4, which probe I already reached (34). Two carriers of 7 in-loop refs each (14 weighted) plus a definition would each sit at nrefs 15-16. The open question is whether any C shape gives two distinct pseudos across the twelve arms without a second jump table or extra instructions.
